components.input_conditions: Prescribed constant h>0 and horizon N>=1.
components.parameter_and_cost_changes: Distance scales by R, values by LR^2 and gradients by LR. No dimension growth.
components.preserved_model_properties: Convexity, C^1 regularity and globally L-Lipschitz gradient after scaling, with the complete argument in the linked lower Theorem.
remaining_obligations: Independent Reviewer must check the linked complete local argument.
A changed method or output requires a new trajectory/error argument.
components.transcript_control: Controls one prescribed GM trajectory; it does not hide the minimizer from arbitrary queries.
components.transformation: Match radial threshold a=1/(2Nh+1) to GM; combine a quadratic core with a linear radial outer segment.

construction.definition: Let a=1/(2Nh+1). Define phi1(z)=||z||^2/2 for ||z||<a and a||z||-a^2/2 for ||z||>=a; phi2(z)=||z||^2/2. Set f_j(x)=LR^2 phi_j(x/R), x0=R nu for a unit vector nu and x*=0. Choose j=1 if 1/(2Nh+1)>=(1-h)^(2N), otherwise j=2.
construction.hidden_objects: No hiding or resisting oracle. These are explicit functions centered at 0.
construction.parameters: L,R,h>0; integers N,d>=1; ||nu||=1. Construction may depend on h,N.
construction.public_information: GM has supplied x0,L,h,N; R is a model promise. Revealing the construction does not change the prescribed GM recurrence, but an unrestricted method is not covered.

escape_conditions.epistemic_note: Direct consequence of the explicit minimizer; not a universal algorithm for the whole smooth convex class.
escape_conditions.scope: This disclosed family beyond prescribed GM
escape_conditions.statement: The minimizer is explicitly 0. A method allowed to exploit this revealed construction can output 0 immediately.

escape_conditions.epistemic_note: Coverage limit only; no general escape complexity is asserted.
escape_conditions.scope: Algorithms other than fixed-step GM with x_N output
escape_conditions.statement: Adaptive steps or different output rules are outside established coverage; their failure is not implied by these trajectories.

hardness_claims.algorithm_coverage: Only deterministic fixed-step GM(h), initialized as constructed, outputting x_N.
hardness_claims.missing_lifting: No lower bound for arbitrary adaptive, randomized, accelerated, averaged-output or unrestricted-query algorithms.
hardness_claims.regime_note: Every h>0,L,R>0 and integers N,d>=1. The existential witness alone establishes no matching upper bound.

oracle_realizations.choices_and_history: Choose one fixed function before the run according to the larger final-gap branch. No history-dependent oracle decisions.
oracle_realizations.cost: One first-order oracle call per query returns a value and full gradient. N update queries produce x_N; optional final evaluation is additional.
oracle_realizations.information_bottleneck: No information bottleneck is asserted. The obstruction is the motion prescribed by fixed-step GM.
oracle_realizations.information_to_error: For f1, x_i=R(1-ih/(2Nh+1))nu and x_N stays outside radius Ra, yielding LR^2/[2(2Nh+1)]. For f2, x_i=R(1-h)^i nu, yielding LR^2(1-h)^(2N)/2. Select the larger branch.
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: At any x in R^d return exact (f_j(x),grad f_j(x)). For f1, grad f1(x)=Lx when ||x||<=Ra and LR a x/||x|| otherwise, with gradient 0 at x=0. For f2, grad f2(x)=Lx.
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: Deterministic exact feedback; repeated queries return the same pair. No sampling or coupling assumption.
